title: Revisiting huntingtin activity and localization signals in the context of protein structure.
authors: Truant, Ray; Harding, Rachel J; Neuman, Kaitlyn; Maiuri, Tamara
one_liner_zh: 该文利用冷冻电镜和AI结构预测回顾亨廷顿蛋白定位信号，但核心是蛋白质结构而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Protein localization signals and activity motifs have been defined within huntingtin since 2003. Advances in technology in protein structure determination by cryo-electron microscopy (EM) have led to 2.6 A resolution structures of huntingtin and HAP40 for the majority of the protein, although structure of the amino terminus with the polyglutamine expansion remains elusive in the context of full-length huntingtin. Recent advances in protein modeling using neural network algorithms trained on a database of known protein structures has resulted in structure predictions that are useful for researchers but need experimental validation. Here, we use both structures solved by cryo-EM as well as modeling centered around experimental structural data to retrospectively revisit huntingtin protein localization signals identified prior to the cryo-EM and AI-enabled structural revolutions. We interrogate these models as well as put forward testable hypotheses of allosteric changes in huntingtin and how they could be affected by polyglutamine expansion. We also extended this methodology to another polyglutamine disease protein, ataxin-1, expanded in Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 1 (SCA1).
abstract_zh: 自2003年以来，亨廷顿蛋白内的蛋白质定位信号和活性基序已被定义。低温电子显微镜（cryo-EM）技术在蛋白质结构测定方面的进步，已获得亨廷顿蛋白及HAP40大部分蛋白质的2.6埃分辨率结构，尽管在全长亨廷顿蛋白背景下，含有多聚谷氨酰胺扩展的氨基末端结构仍难以捉摸。近期，利用基于已知蛋白质结构数据库训练的神经网络算法进行蛋白质建模的进展，产生了对研究人员有用但需实验验证的结构预测。在此，我们利用cryo-EM解析的结构以及围绕实验结构数据为中心的建模，回顾性地重新审视在cryo-EM和AI驱动的结构革命之前识别的亨廷顿蛋白定位信号。我们探究这些模型，并提出关于亨廷顿蛋白变构变化及其可能受多聚谷氨酰胺扩展影响的可测试假设。我们还将此方法扩展至另一种多聚谷氨酰胺疾病蛋白——ataxin-1，该蛋白在脊髓小脑性共济失调1型（SCA1）中发生扩展。
